map.大棚卷膜时间（温度/风速）建议 使用指南: Greenhouse Film Rolling Timing Recommendation User Guide
map.输入大棚内外温度、外界风速与棚膜通风面积，估算自然通风降温能力并给出卷膜开启高度: Enter the indoor and outdoor greenhouse temperatures, external wind speed, and film vent area to estimate natural ventilation cooling and recommend roll-up height and duration, helping growers control temperature and humidity during hot periods.
map.建议通风量 = (棚内温度 − 棚外温度) × 棚膜面积 × 0.5 (m³/m: Suggested ventilation = (indoor − outdoor temperature) × film area × 0.5 (m³/min); roll-up height = min(ΔT ÷ 15, 1) × max(1 − wind speed ÷ 8, 0.2) × 100%
map.以棚内外温差驱动通风量经验估算（系数 0.5 为经验值，单位 m³/min）。卷: Ventilation volume is estimated empirically from the indoor-outdoor temperature difference (the 0.5 coefficient is empirical, in m³/min). Roll-up height multiplies a temperature-difference factor by a wind factor: a 15 °C difference gives full opening (factor 1), and higher wind lowers the opening (at 8 m/s it drops to 20%). Rolling the film is not advised above 6 m/s or when the indoor temperature is not above outdoor; indoor temperatures above 28 °C and 32 °C trigger corresponding action prompts.
map.按棚内外温差与风速建议卷膜开度与时段。: Recommend roll-up opening and timing from the indoor-outdoor difference and wind speed.
map.目标维持昼温上限、夜温下限与湿度阈值。: Target maintaining the daytime upper limit, nighttime lower limit, and humidity threshold.
map.用于病害防控与节能平衡。: Used for disease control and the energy-saving balance.
map.：棚内 32℃（超 28℃ 上限）、室外 18℃、风速 2 级。建议卷膜 1/2: : indoor 32 °C (above the 28 °C limit), outdoor 18 °C, wind force 2. Roll the film to half for 40 minutes to cool to 26 °C, then reduce to a quarter for holding; if wind rises to force 5, open only the top vent slightly to prevent seedling scorch.
map.大风卷膜易损膜、灌冷风致闪苗。风速预警下应减小开度或只开顶通风，保苗优先于降温。: Strong wind can damage the film and dumping cold air in can scorch seedlings. Under a wind alert, reduce the opening or vent only at the top — protecting seedlings comes before cooling.
map.夜间要卷膜吗？: Should the Film Be Rolled at Night?
map.一般夜间闭膜保温，但高湿连阴天可微开顶口排湿防病。看『温湿双目标』而非单一温度。: Normally close the film at night to retain heat, but on humid overcast days open the top slightly to vent moisture and prevent disease. Aim for a dual temperature-and-humidity target rather than temperature alone.
